gate: R02 (BETA) — durable target preflight and isolated target verification
approval: owner approved one isolated window <=24h with a 0 ceiling, teardown commands and post-shutdown residual checks at close

target.vm: pb-qual-backend-01 (e2-medium, us-west1-a, no public address, cloud-platform scope)
target.disk: pb-qual-data-01 (regional pd-standard 200GB, replica zones us-west1-a + us-west1-b, device pb-data)
target.egress: Cloud NAT pb-qual-nat on router pb-qual-router (the VM has no public address, so apt/registry needed NAT)
target.deleted: VM, regional disk, router and NAT all deleted at drill close

immutable_digest_deploy.evidence: docker pull by digest succeeded and RepoDigests matched the pinned sha256:6f81c4c3...; health responded from the running container

single_attached_ext4_writer.evidence: findmnt showed /dev/sdb ext4 on /srv/parkingbreaker/data; disk users listed exactly the drill VM

old_owner_fencing.evidence: production deployment_policy.regional_owner evaluated against the live disk JSON: single owner True; other VM refused; two writers refused; wrong device refused; non-replicated disk refused
old_owner_fencing.note: the application itself does not lock the SQLite file across containers (a second container started); fencing is enforced by the deployment policy and lifecycle, exactly as the compose warning states -- operational guardrails are mandatory, not optional

data_survival_full_stop_restart.evidence: an append-only boot log on the regional disk accumulated across a full instance stop/start (boots=2 with both timestamps) and health returned 200 from the same data directory after restart

private_tls_8443.evidence: Caddy served the private host on 8443 with the provisioned certificate (subject CN=qual-private.internal) and /health answered 200 over TLS

public_refusal_of_internal_routes.evidence: GET /internal/dispatch through the private TLS gateway returned 404; /webhooks/stripe was proxied (400 from the app), proving customer routes remain reachable while worker routes are refused

fresh_monitor_poll_and_sweep.reason: the drill ran the API image only; the monitor/worker/scheduler containers and the lifecycle lock/health sweep were out of this window's scope

not_covered: full lifecycle.sh --apply run (lock, image prepare, migration gates) on the target
worker + scheduler + monitor containers and a recorded monitor poll/sweep
Cloud Run frontend routed to the private VM over the approved topology
P06 joined Stripe+Lob qualification (still needs the Stripe test key)

residual_checks_after_teardown.disks: pb-qual-backup-01 (50GB, pre-existing R03 backup target, ~$2/mo) — deliberately kept
residual_checks_after_teardown.addresses: only the production LB addresses (parkingbreaker-ip, parkingbreaker-ipv6)
